description: Cacat cat ditemukan di final inspection. 14/120 pcs NG di lot LOT-CT-2463, oven line 3. Temuan QC patrol.
containment: Lot LOT-CT-2463 di-hold; cek DFT dan adhesi 100% stok.

correctiveAction: Repair the air dryer, add a dew point monitor and drain filters each shift.

title: Out of spec on CNC part
description: Position of holes out of tolerance on all parts in lot. 33/200 pcs NG, lot LOT-CNC-2466, CNC-04. First article was not re-checked after program edit. Customer complaint, 8D requested.
containment: Lot LOT-CNC-2466 on hold; 100% gauge check of stock.
confirmedRootCause: Wrong work offset loaded at changeover, confirmed by program and offset audit.
correctiveAction: Lock offsets per part number and require a first-article CMM check after changeover.

title: Panjang step shaft salah
description: Dimensi terukur di luar toleransi drawing. 18/200 pcs NG di lot LOT-CNC-2423, CNC-11. First article tdk dicek ulang setelah edit program. Temuan QC patrol.
containment: Lot LOT-CNC-2423 di-hold; cek gauge 100% stok.

correctiveAction: Lock offsets per part number and require a first-article CMM check after changeover.

containment: Lot LOT-DC-2507 on hold; 100% X-ray of stock.

containment: Lot LOT-DC-2602 di-hold; X-ray 100% stok.

title: Shaft diameter outside tolerance

containment: Suspect parts segregated, shipment blocked, 100% gauge check.
